programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Valencia" - "Partizan"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Panathinaikos" - "Olympiacos"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Ligue 1. PSG - Paris
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Reptile Planet
programme.desc: Skittering, swimming and even gliding, over 12,000 species of reptiles roam the world. Crocs, turtles, snakes and lizards have ancestors as old as the dinosaurs and evolution as their friend. These cold-blooded creatures have adapted in clever and lethal ways, from armoured skin and poisonous venom to record-breaking bite force and even blood squirting eyes. This is Reptile Planet!

programme.title: Python Invasion
programme.desc: Scientists and hunters team up to fight one of the biggest ecological threats to the Florida Everglades: the Burmese python. In the 1990s, pet pythons were released into the wild and have eaten their way through the food chain. Today, nobody knows how many there are, but estimates may be in the hundreds of thousands. We follow the scientists as they track, gather data, and try to understand better how Pythons reproduce and adapt in the Everglades. Ian Bartoszerk and his team at the Conservancy of Southwest Florida use male scout snakes to lead them to females with the potential to lay up to eighty eggs at a time. At the U.S.G.S., Amy Yackle and Mark Sandfoss work in tandem with wildlife biologists from the National Park Service and the University of Florida to battle female reproduction on another front — Alligator Alley.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. Riding powerful currents, the tiny adventurers arrived in strange new lands, reshaping traditions for deserts, tropics … and even among humans. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovers penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their enduring search for new worlds.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. Whether an animal is fighting for food, shelter or for survival itself, there are no guarantees. Sometimes even strength of numbers is not enough. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

Surviving in these vastly different environments require cunning, persistence and the ability to adapt to a changing climate. This is the story of Bertie's quest to capture these wild environments firsthand.

programme.title: Snow School
programme.desc: When every day is a snow day, school is always in session! Snowy climates can make for harsh living, and adulting is hard no matter where you are, but these young are flourishing; a baby walrus gets a swim lesson from Mom, young stoats' playtime teaches them how to hunt, otter pups take a slide and learn to avoid predators, and owlets practice leaving the nest. We'll also see penguin chicks daring to take the leap, an unlikely team of mismatched teenagers, and others learning how to weather and thrive in the coldest climates, thanks to their snowy homeschooling, some very dedicated parents, and a lot of trial and error.

programme.desc: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most dangerous mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean's most famous and fearsome predators: the great white shark. programme.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory is in the Azores, a marine sanctuary and vital pitstop for migrating ocean predators off the coast of Portugal. It's feeding season, as thousands of normally elusive predators join forces to hunt and feed on super-shoals of fish known as bait balls. A vast ocean and battling storms challenge the team for a chance to film the most spectacular feeding frenzy of Bertie's career.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He's here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen

Now an accomplished zoologist, Randall is continuing his studies into wild and exotic species, visiting harsh landscapes and unrelenting environments to explore these animal's behaviours. programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: World's Weirdest
programme.desc: World's Weirdest is a documentary series revolving around the strangest, freakiest, weirdest animals and their behaviors in the animal kingdom. Take this amazing journey to the animal world and have a look at creatures who survive in extreme environments, alien-looking body parts and camouflage, fish that can change its sex, toads that explode, koalas and their disgusting diet and all kinds of other weirdest creatures Mother Nature has to offer.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Typically South Africa is known for the Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, elephants and rhinos. But not for Lucy Cooke, advocate and avenger for the lesser-known and unloved animals of the world. Lucy's on a hunt for the more enigmatic Freaky Five: Cape vultures, sungazer girdled lizards, golden-brown baboon tarantulas, ground pangolins, and chacma baboons. The Freaky Five are all important to South Africans and their traditions. Mystical and mysterious, these five animals represent a side of South African culture that the tourists and conservation donors both often overlook. But Lucy Cooke is on a mission to change all of that!

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When Uncle Budrick is held captive as King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him, with a little help from her new friends, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn. Max attempts to enlist the help of a wizard named Mumblin, but learns that he's retired and unwilling to aid in their mission. Afraid that she will put her new friends in more danger, Max goes off on her own to rescue Uncle Budrick, but is surprised when Simon, Millie, & Kevyn follow her, determined to help. The four later find themselves mixed up in a royal jousting event, where they are chased by a wild boar. Luckily, Mumblin decides to help and appears, just in time to save them. With Mumblin now on their side, Max and co. attempt to rescue Uncle Budrick, but when a tentacled creature emerges from the moat, Max and the others must flee without Uncle Budrick. Now bonded as a group, Max, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn, vow to return to save Uncle Budrick, together. Their mission clear, the newly formed team decide on their new nickname: the Midknights.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.desc: Having filled up another wish card, Hazel is enjoying a fun, fantasy wish. She tricks them into publicly talking about magic at a fake museum exhibit, records the evidence, and then takes them to Fairy Court. Now, Hazel must prove that Cosmo and Wanda are innocent, or else lose them forever. // Frustrated by her mom's split attention between work and home, Hazel wishes to be her assistant to spend more time with her. Even though being a working adult is hard, Hazel is excited to be spending so much quality time with Angela. But when the puppet standing in for Hazel at school gets called into the nurse's office, Angela rushes off to take care of it and Hazel must give the presentation instead!

When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: At an awards ceremony for Marcus, Hazel wishes the night would be extra special for him. But when her Cosmo and Wanda fidget toys are confiscated by security, Hazel enlists the help of a mysterious janitor to find them - a janitor who turns out to be Denzel Crocker, unrenowned fairy hunter! He vows to capture the fairies for himself, so Hazel goes head-to-head with Crocker in an epic fight to get her fairies back. // Hazel and her class spend the night in the Dimmsonian museum. Throughout the night, Dev makes a series of wishes to try and bother Hazel and her friends, but in the process, accidentally brings on a spirit uprising. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda discover Dev not only has a fairy, but it's Cosmo and Wanda's son, Peri! The whole team will have to work together to put the ancient spirits back to rest and save their sleepover.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Winn, and Jasmine go to Patty Possum's Party Playground, an entertainment fun zone for kids. Hazel wishes the animatronic Patty Possum would come to life. Patty joins the friends for the night and even brings them up to perform on stage! But at closing time, Patty doesn't want to lose her new friends, so she locks them inside the Party Playground. Cosmo and Wanda's wands are stuck in the claw machine, so they can't help! They will have to evade this unhinged mascot without magic and find a way out. // Wanting Angela and Marcus to have a romantic anniversary, Hazel wishes that they would "fall in love all over again." When the wish causes her parents to forget each other, Hazel calls on Cupid to make them fall back in love. Upset that Hazel undid his work, Cupid challenges her to a competition in which Hazel and Marcus must compete with Cupid and Angela's old flame, Brewster, for Angela's affection. Can she beat Cupid at his own game and get her parents to fall back in love?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: On a fairy family trip to Fairy World, Dev convinces Hazel to steal Peri's wand and explore Fairy World. Cosmo, Wanda and Peri sneak into Jorgen's office and use his tracker to find them. Hazel and Dev end up stuck in the Un-Wish Zone, trapped by the Un-wish Dragon. Together they must battle the dragon and find their way back to their fairies before Jorgen finds out! // When band and orchestra tryouts happen at school, Hazel finds herself stuck in the middle of a rivalry between the two. Rather than choose a side, she wishes to be good at all instruments and ends up in both. Exhausted from the double life she's living, she wishes that the band and orchestra had nothing to be rivals about. In granting the wish, Cosmo and Wanda get rid of all music on Earth. Hazel, with the help of the Nmusic Phairy (silent N), must restore music to Earth and end this rivalry once and for all!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. They go the mall and have a blast doing "teenage things" while they wait for the movie. But, as a side effect of her wish, Hazel starts going through the fairy version of puberty: pasta puberty! As she struggles to deal with pesto pimples and mozzarella mood swings, Hazel wishes that Cosmo and Wanda would just get lost! They disappear, leaving Hazel to deal with the zany pasta puberty alone. // Hazel wishes to be a fairy to join Cosmo and Wanda at their Fairy Convention, but since it's against Da Rules, she settles on looking like a fairy instead. Once at the con, however, Hazel stumbles into the DMV booth and signs a "Fairy-fication" certificate, turning her into a real fairy! It also brings her anti-fairy into existence, who steals the certificate. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must get the certificate back from her anti-fairy, or Hazel will be stuck as a fairy forever!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.desc: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks hinges on David Seville, a single father whose everyday struggle is to bring up his kids, 3 chipmunks: Alvin- the oldest brother, the leader, not so good at school, Simon- the smartest of the three brothers, exemplary pupil and Theodore- the youngest one, the chubby one, the gentle one. David "Dave" sometimes loses his temper and then he is shouting "Alvinnnnn!!!". Music is an obligatory pleasant part of every episode. Every episode touches up-to-date issues of both adults and kids from modern life like real problems at school, dating and so on. Thanks to their own foolishness chipmunks often find themselves in ridiculous situations and have to use their creativity to get out of a mess, that provides us with a good opportunity to enjoy their joyful adventures.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Leipcigo „LawnBallsport“ - Lėverkuzeno „Bayer“
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Kit Harington in un action storico dal regista di "Resident Evil". Mentre la lava del Vesuvio sommerge la città, un eroico gladiatore deve salvare la sua amata da un senatore romano.

programme.title: Game Night - Indovina chi muore stasera?
programme.desc: Jason Bateman e Rachel McAdams in una mystery-comedy. Un gruppo di amici impegnati in un gioco di societa' scoprono che il crimine su cui stanno indagando per finta e' davvero accaduto.

programme.title: Le belve
programme.desc: Aaron Johnson, John Travolta e Benicio Del Toro in un thriller di Oliver Stone. Due giovani coltivatori di marijuana entrano in conflitto con i crudeli narcotrafficanti messicani.

programme.title: Il gladiatore II
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Paul Mescal e Denzel Washington nell'atteso sequel del suo film leggendario. Anni dopo la morte di Marco Aurelio, suo nipote Lucio, ridotto in schiavitù, combatte per vendicare la morte della sua sposa e mettere fine alla tirannia di Caracalla e Geta.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Il diavolo veste Prada
programme.desc: Meryl Streep e Anne Hathaway in una commedia 'glamour'. Una giornalista viene assunta da una prestigiosa rivista di moda di New York. La dispotica direttrice le rendera' la vita impossibile.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Nell'ottavo capitolo della saga, Tom Cruise alias Agente Hunt corre contro il tempo per impedire allo spietato sistema di Intelligenza Artificiale chiamato Entita' di distruggere il pianeta.

programme.title: Tolo Tolo
programme.desc: Checco Zalone dirige e interpreta la commedia campione d'incassi scritta con Paolo Virzi. Inseguito dai creditori, Checco fugge in Africa, ma una guerra ne scombina i programmi.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: Un film Minecraft
programme.desc: I formidabili Jason Momoa e Jack Black nel fantastico live action basato sull'omonimo videogame. Scaraventati attraverso un portale in un bizzarro paese delle meraviglie chiamato Overworld, quattro improvvisati avventurieri devono portare a termine una magica missione per tornare a casa.

programme.title: Il gladiatore II
programme.desc: Ridley Scott dirige Paul Mescal e Denzel Washington nell'atteso sequel del suo film leggendario. Anni dopo la morte di Marco Aurelio, suo nipote Lucio, ridotto in schiavitù, combatte per vendicare la morte della sua sposa e mettere fine alla tirannia di Caracalla e Geta.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Action con Robert De Niro e John Travolta. Un ufficiale americano si ritira sui monti per dimenticare gli orrori della guerra in Bosnia. La visita di un ex soldato serbo riapre le ferite.

programme.title: Una terapia di gruppo
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Claudio Bisio diretta da Paolo Costella. Per errore, sei pazienti ricevono appuntamento dallo psicologo alla stessa ora con esiti inaspettati.

programme.title: Tolo Tolo
programme.desc: Checco Zalone dirige e interpreta la commedia campione d'incassi scritta con Paolo Virzi. Inseguito dai creditori, Checco fugge in Africa, ma una guerra ne scombina i programmi.

programme.title: Riunione di famiglia (Non sposate le mie figlie 3)
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: Ghostbusters - Minaccia glaciale
programme.desc: New York: L'apertura di un antico e misterioso manufatto risveglia dal sonno eterno un esercito di demoni malvagi e la Terra rischia una nuova era glaciale. Vecchi e nuovi ghostbusters si uniscono per evitare l'Apocalisse.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: Sole a catinelle
programme.desc: Checco Zalone in una commedia travolgente. Un venditore di aspirapolveri ha promesso al figlio una vacanza da sogno. Un colpo di fortuna li condurra' in un mondo di feste esclusive.

programme.title: Un film Minecraft
programme.desc: I formidabili Jason Momoa e Jack Black nel fantastico live action basato sull'omonimo videogame. Scaraventati attraverso un portale in un bizzarro paese delle meraviglie chiamato Overworld, quattro improvvisati avventurieri devono portare a termine una magica missione per tornare a casa.

programme.title: Jack Reacher - Punto di non ritorno
programme.desc: Action con Tom Cruise nei panni del personaggio nato dalla penna di Lee Child. Reacher deve scoprire la congiura che ha portato all'arresto di una collega e fare i conti con un segreto.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: The Equalizer - Il vendicatore
programme.desc: Denzel Washington in un action ispirato alla serie anni '80 "Un giustiziere a New York". Un ex federale torna ad affrontare il crimine per salvare una giovane prostituta.

programme.title: La banda dei Babbi Natale
programme.desc: Aldo, Giovanni e Giacomo in una brillante commedia natalizia. Arrestati la notte della Vigilia, tre babbi natale raccontano le loro esistenze complicate per dimostrare di essere innocenti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il gioco delle coppie
programme.desc: La Commissaria Fusco e per i suoi agenti indagano sulla misteriosa scomparsa di una donna. Pasquali fa di tutto per scampare al matrimonio con Susanita, escogitando scuse sempre più improbabili pur di rimandare l'inevitabile.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Italia 1982 - Una storia azzurra
programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: Ligabue - 30 anni in un giorno
programme.desc: Ligabue fa i conti con i suoi ricordi e con la sua carriera nel biopic incentrato sul leggendario concerto di Campovolo del 2022.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: C'era una volta a... Hollywood
programme.desc: Oscar a Brad Pitt nel film di Quentin Tarantino con Leonardo DiCaprio e Margot Robbie. 1969: le vicende di Sharon Tate si intrecciano con quelle di un attore in declino e del suo stuntman.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Le assaggiatrici
programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.title: Unbroken
programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Marcello mio
programme.desc: Chiara Mastroianni, attrice e figlia d'arte di Marcello Mastroianni e Catherine Deneuve, e il regista Christophe Honore' confezionano un ritratto del grande attore, in concorso a Cannes.

programme.title: The Blues Brothers
programme.desc: John Belushi e Dan Aykroyd nell'irriverente commedia musicale di John Landis. Per salvare l'orfanotrofio in cui sono cresciuti, due fratelli riuniscono la loro band per un concerto.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Povere creature!
programme.desc: Londra XIX secolo: una donna morta suicida nel Tamigi viene riportata in vita da uno scienziato. Bramosa di conoscere e totalmente libera, la rediviva creatura inizia un instancabile percorso di formazione e di emancipazione.

programme.title: Salvate il soldato Ryan
programme.desc: 5 Oscar per il film di guerra firmato Steven Spielberg, con Tom Hanks e Matt Damon. Dopo lo sbarco in Normandia, un plotone va in cerca dell'unico soldato superstite di quattro fratelli.

programme.title: Fuga in Normandia
programme.desc: Da una storia vera, l'ultimo film per Michael Caine prima del suo ritiro dalle scene e per l'indimenticabile Glenda Jackson. L'anziano Bernie fugge dall'ospizio per raggiungere la Francia e celebrare con gli altri veterani il 70esimo anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Senza sangue
programme.desc: Angelina Jolie dirige Salma Hayek in un intenso dramma ispirato al romanzo di Alessandro Baricco. Una donna ritrova dopo anni uno dei responsabili del massacro della sua famiglia e deve decidere come sia giusto vendicarsi.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Cailee Spaeny nella pellicola di Sofia Coppola che racconta il grande e turbolento amore tra Priscilla Beaulieu e il re del rock and roll Elvis Presley (Jacob Elordi).

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Il colore della libertà
programme.desc: Biopic prodotto da Spike Lee. 1961: Bob Zellner, studente universitario dell'Alabama e nipote di un membro del Ku Klux Klan, decide di schierarsi in difesa dei diritti degli afroamericani.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Scarface
programme.desc: Al Pacino nel gangster-movie capolavoro di Brian De Palma, sceneggiato da Oliver Stone. Il rifugiato cubano Tony Montana scala i vertici della malavita e diventa il re del narcotraffico.

programme.title: Berlinguer - La grande ambizione
programme.desc: Elio Germano, diretto da Andrea Segre, nel biopic su uno dei grandi protagonisti della Prima Repubblica. Il film rilegge un pezzo della nostra storia, e sullo sfondo degli anni 70 ripercorre la vita privata e la militanza politica del leader del Partito Comunista Italiano.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: Marcello mio
programme.desc: Chiara Mastroianni, attrice e figlia d'arte di Marcello Mastroianni e Catherine Deneuve, e il regista Christophe Honore' confezionano un ritratto del grande attore, in concorso a Cannes.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Il buono, il brutto, il cattivo
programme.desc: Versione restaurata del celebre western di Sergio Leone, con Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef ed Eli Wallach. Guerra di secessione americana: tre pistoleri inseguono un carico d'oro.

programme.title: The interpreter
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack dirige un thriller con Nicole Kidman e Sean Penn. Un'interprete dell'ONU scopre un complotto omicida ai danni di un capo di stato africano e finisce nei guai.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Cuori ribelli
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Nicole Kidman nel dramma romantico di Ron Howard. Due giovani irlandesi, Shannon e Joseph, si trasferiscono a Boston in cerca di fortuna affrontando mille peripezie.

programme.title: Habemus Papam
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta, con Michel Piccoli e Margherita Buy, una pellicola su un'inaspettata crisi esistenziale. Il nuovo Papa, assalito dall'ansia, rinuncia alla sua missione.

programme.title: Era mio figlio
programme.desc: Todd Robinson dirige un cast d’eccezione per un war movie tratto da una storia vera. Il paracadutista William Pitsenbarger fu un eroe caduto nella guerra del Vietnam. Trent’anni dopo un ambizioso membro del Pentagono cercherà di fargli ottenere la medaglia d’onore.

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Jurassic World - Questo O Quello - Jurassic World.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al cult di Steven Spielberg, dal romanzo di Michael Crichton. Uno scienziato crea un parco a tema preistorico, popolato da animali estinti generati in laboratorio.

programme.title: Il mondo perduto: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo diretto da Steven Spielberg, con Jeff Goldblum e Julianne Moore. Due scienziati ostacolano un criminale che vuole trasportare i feroci dinosauri nello zoo di San Diego.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Sam Neill nel terzo capitolo della saga con protagoniste le bestie preistoriche. Il paleontologo Grant torna sull'isola di Sorna e scopre l'esistenza di nuovi mostri più evoluti.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Jurassic World - Questo O Quello - Jurassic World.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel primo capitolo della nuova trilogia prodotta da Spielberg. Per attrarre più visitatori, gli scienziati progettano un dinosauro geneticamente modificato.

programme.title: Jurassic World – Il regno distrutto
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel secondo capitolo della nuova trilogia. Owen e Claire scoprono una cospirazione mentre tentano di salvare i dinosauri da un'eruzione.

programme.title: Jurassic World - Il Dominio
programme.desc: Il cast delle due spettacolari trilogie si incontra nel sesto capitolo di successo. Dopo la distruzione di Nublar, i dinosauri vagano liberi sulla Terra invasa da locuste giganti.

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.desc: In honor of Dump Day in Piqua- celebrating the creation of the dump - George and Harold try to earn extra credit by creating a trash-alanche. programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants
programme.desc: In part one of a two-part season finale, the Melvins create a final exam that George and Harold will be sure to fail: the Doom Dome. To ensure success, Melvinborg injects Melvin's cells with nanobots, giving him heightened powers. But when George and Harold find out, they crank the nanobots to the max, causing Melvin to grow into a giant! The boys enlist Captain Underpants to fight the jealous nerd, but their victory only loses the nanobots onto Piqua...

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants

programme.title: Guess with Jess

programme.title: THE MAGICIAN
programme.desc: A talented young magician falls for a princess betrothed to his former teacher, leading to a fierce showdown between the two powerful magicians.

programme.title: BEAR MAN
programme.desc: Two bears from the Institute of techonolgy have turned into humans after eating garlic and mugwort. Yet, one has grown up into a police, while one has become a gangster...

programme.title: THE NEGOTIATION
programme.desc: An arms dealer kidnapped two Koreans in Bangkok where the hostages were in fact held in an abandoned children's home in South Korea, when the kidnapper's motivations becomes clearer.

programme.title: RACE TO FREEDOM: UM BOK DONG
programme.desc: K-pop star Rain portrays Um Bok-dong, an unlikely hero in a government-organized bicycle race during the Japanese colonial era. Defeating Japanese rivals, his victories inspire locals and resistance fighters.

programme.title: BEHIND THE SHADOWS
programme.desc: Yun-ho, born weak and destined to die young, is drawn to his loyal friend, Jae-un. In the conservative Joseon Dynasty, Yun-ho disguises as a girl to confess his love to Jae-un before his arranged marriage.

programme.title: DEADMAN
programme.desc: An ace in the barge business makes money by selling his name, is falsely accused of embezzling billions. He fights to reclaim his stolen life from those tied to him solely by name.

programme.title: INNOCENT WITNESS
programme.desc: A housekeeper is charged with murder. Her attorney is surprised to learn the only witness to the crime is a teenage girl with Asperger's. Will the girl be able to provide a valid statement?

programme.title: PENINSULA
programme.desc: Set four years after the zombie outbreak, a former soldier and his team return to the zombie-infested wastelands to retrieve a truck of money and try to escape from it alive.

programme.title: Catch the Ghost Ep3
programme.desc: Yoo Ryung, a zealous rookie detective meets Go Ji-suk, a station chief who avoids cases and seeks stability. He ends up cleaning up after the problems she causes and starts his life anew.

programme.title: Catch the Ghost Ep4
programme.desc: Yoo Ryung, a zealous rookie detective meets Go Ji-suk, a station chief who avoids cases and seeks stability. He ends up cleaning up after the problems she causes and starts his life anew.

programme.title: LOVE, LIES
programme.desc: A gisaeng is consumed by jealousy after her friend finds success as a pop singer and her lover falls for her. Feeling betrayed, things begin to fall apart as she tries to regain the things she lost.

programme.title: FIST \u0026 FURIOUS
programme.desc: A former detective grants permission to a freelance video journalist to cover his revenge journey on a mob boss whom previously killed his partner during an investigation.

programme.title: MY WORST NEIGHBOR
programme.desc: In a house with little soundproofing, a man and a woman living next door started a noise war. They then cohabitate through the wall, and catching up in subtle emotions...

programme.title: ORDINARY PERSON

programme.title: THE ODD FAMILY: ZOMBIE ON SALE
programme.desc: When a pharmaceutical company's illegal experiments inadvertently create a zombie, the quirky Park family discovers an interesting side effect to the virus and tries to profit from it.

programme.title: THE BEAST
programme.desc: Two rival detectives compete against each other to catch the notorious killer who shakes up Korea by their gruesome murders.

programme.title: A Hundred Memories Ep7
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s, it depicts the friendship between 2 bus attendants Yeong-rye and Jong-hee, and their affectionate first love surrounding Jae-pil.

programme.title: CSI S5 E09 - Mea Culpa
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures S1 ep 13
programme.desc: A clairvoyant repairman fearful of ghosts is forced to help them cross over so they can leave him in peace. Will he be able to get these ghosts and their love ones, at the same time face his fear of them?

programme.title: The Last Woman Standing ep 11

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Johnny English, a bumbling British agent, teams up with an Interpol agent and attempts to locate a French billionaire who has stolen the crown jewels.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, an expert agent, confronts a worldwide plot. To prevent a nuclear crisis, he collaborates secretly with his team after his organisation is deceived.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: When in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max, a wanderer, joins the rebel warrior Imperator Furiosa against his will in order to dethrone an autocrat who controls water supply to the land.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur is born with the ability to communicate with marine creatures. He goes on a quest to retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and protect the water world.

programme.title: The Nun II
programme.desc: In 1956 France, Sister Irene faces the terrifying demon Valak, racing against time to save a convent and the surrounding community from evil.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Detective Alex Murphy is on the brink of death after being critically injured in a bomb blast. However, a technology company transforms him into RoboCop, a one-of-a-kind cyborg police officer.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: When his former superior, Colonel Samuel, asks him to join him on a special mission in Afghanistan, Rambo declines. However, when he is held hostage and tortured, Rambo decides to step in.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: An elite team of US Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA operative. However, things become complicated when they come across a much larger global threat in the process.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: An elite team of US Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA operative. However, things become complicated when they come across a much larger global threat in the process.

programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embaressing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another around against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: A convict escapes from prison and guises as a pastor to save himself from the sheriff. The sheriff cannot be outsmarted and is determined to take him into custody.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Megan Walsh, a special agent, is curious about teenage life experiences so she fakes her own death and enrols in high school. Soon, she realises the troubles of the high school life.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: A detective from Hong Kong and a wisecracking detective from Los Angeles must overcome their differences and work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: In 1985, Ivan Drago killed Apollo Creed in a tragic boxing match. Under the guidance of his trainer Rocky, Apollo's son Adonis confronts Drago's son in an ultimate showdown.
